# ==============================================================================
# Toob-Boot Master Build Script
# 
# Relevant Specs: 
# - docs/structure_plan.md (Global C-flags, Malloc limits, Project Structure)
# - docs/dev_plan.md (M-BUILD Setup, P10 Verification)
# - docs/testing_requirements.md (P10 Verification, Zero Allocation)
# ==============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Manifest Compiler Bridge (Auto-Generated Device Topology)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load toob_config.cmake before project() so declarative chip/arch compiler flags
# (TOOB_CHIP_C_FLAGS, TOOB_CHIP_ASM_FLAGS, TOOB_CHIP_LD_FLAGS) are visible inside
# CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE during compiler initialization.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/toob_config.cmake")
    if(NOT TOOB_CONFIG_LOADED)
        set(TOOB_CONFIG_LOADED TRUE)
        include("${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/toob_config.cmake")
    endif()
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "No generated toob_config.cmake found at ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/.\n"
        "This file is generated by 'toob build' and must exist before CMake runs.\n"
        "Run 'toob build --native' instead of invoking CMake directly."
    )
endif()

project(toob-boot C ASM)

# Set default manifest if not provided by the user
if(NOT TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST AND TOOB_MANIFEST)
    set(TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST "${TOOB_MANIFEST}")
endif()
if(NOT TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST)
    set(TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cli/examples/manifests/device.toml")
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Global Safety Limits (P10 / NASA Standards)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enforce C17 Strict
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Zero-Allocation: Absolute Ban of malloc/free/realloc
add_compile_definitions(
    malloc=MALLOC_FORBIDDEN 
    free=FREE_FORBIDDEN
    realloc=REALLOC_FORBIDDEN
    calloc=CALLOC_FORBIDDEN
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Security & Anti-Slop Compiler Flags
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Function to apply modular, ultra-strict P10 flags to all our proprietary targets.
# This prevents poisoning third-party libraries (e.g. 'monocypher')
# and allows us to enable stack-protector consistently across stages.
function(toob_apply_strict_flags TARGET_NAME ALLOW_STACK_PROTECTOR)
    target_compile_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        -Wall 
        -Wextra 
        -Werror 
        -Wconversion 
        -Wshadow
        -Wformat=2 
        -Wstrict-prototypes 
        -Wmissing-prototypes
        -fno-common
        # Force Size Optimization for P10 28KB Budget
        -Os
        # Dead Code Elimination (linker will gc later)
        -ffunction-sections 
        -fdata-sections
    )
    
    # Propagate GC-sections across static libraries and final executables.
    target_link_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        -Wl,--gc-sections
    )

    # P10 Bare-Metal Linker Protection (cross-compilation only, excluded on host SIL):
    if(NOT TOOB_ARCH STREQUAL "host")
        # GNU ld rejects multiple strong symbol definitions by default; -Wl,--allow-multiple-definition is banned.
        target_link_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
            -nostartfiles
            -Wl,-Map=${TARGET_NAME}.map
        )
        target_compile_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
            -fno-builtin        # Prevent GCC from silently linking libc built-ins (e.g. memcpy, printf)
        )
        if(NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
            target_compile_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE -fstack-usage)
        endif()
    endif()

    if(ALLOW_STACK_PROTECTOR)
        target_compile_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE -fstack-protector-strong)
    endif()
endfunction()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.5 Hardware Mock & Profile Security Options (Must precede cmake/toob_*.cmake)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

option(TOOB_DOUBLE_VERIFY "Enable double-execution of Ed25519 verification for fault-injection resistance" ON)
if(TOOB_DOUBLE_VERIFY)
    add_compile_definitions(TOOB_DOUBLE_VERIFY=1)
else()
    add_compile_definitions(TOOB_DOUBLE_VERIFY=0)
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED TOOB_PROFILE)
    set(TOOB_PROFILE "dev" CACHE STRING "Build profile (dev or production)")
else()
    set(TOOB_PROFILE "${TOOB_PROFILE}" CACHE STRING "Build profile (dev or production)" FORCE)
endif()
string(TOLOWER "${TOOB_PROFILE}" _TOOB_PROFILE_LOWER)

if(_TOOB_PROFILE_LOWER STREQUAL "production")
    option(TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES "Legacy alias for TOOB_MOCK_HW" OFF)
    if(NOT DEFINED TOOB_MOCK_HW)
        set(TOOB_MOCK_HW OFF CACHE BOOL "Use mock hardware driver TUs in dev profile")
    else()
        set(TOOB_MOCK_HW ${TOOB_MOCK_HW} CACHE BOOL "Use mock hardware driver TUs in dev profile" FORCE)
    endif()

    if(TOOB_MOCK_HW OR TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SECURITY VIOLATION: TOOB_PROFILE=production forbids mock hardware drivers (TOOB_MOCK_HW / TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES).")
    endif()
    if(TOOB_MOCK_TEST)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SECURITY VIOLATION: TOOB_PROFILE=production forbids TOOB_MOCK_TEST.")
    endif()
    if(TOOB_STAGE0_DEV_BYPASS)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SECURITY VIOLATION: TOOB_PROFILE=production forbids TOOB_STAGE0_DEV_BYPASS.")
    endif()
    if(TOOB_ALLOW_PUBLIC_JOURNAL_KEY_DEGRADATION)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SECURITY VIOLATION: TOOB_PROFILE=production forbids TOOB_ALLOW_PUBLIC_JOURNAL_KEY_DEGRADATION.")
    endif()

    add_compile_definitions(
        TOOB_PROFILE_PRODUCTION=1
        TOOB_ALLOW_PUBLIC_JOURNAL_KEY_DEGRADATION=0
    )
else()
    option(TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES "Legacy alias for TOOB_MOCK_HW" ON)
    if(NOT DEFINED TOOB_MOCK_HW)
        set(TOOB_MOCK_HW ${TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES} CACHE BOOL "Use mock hardware driver TUs in dev profile")
    else()
        set(TOOB_MOCK_HW ${TOOB_MOCK_HW} CACHE BOOL "Use mock hardware driver TUs in dev profile" FORCE)
    endif()
endif()

if(TOOB_MOCK_HW)
    add_compile_definitions(TOOB_MOCK_HW=1 TOOB_MOCK_EFUSES=1)
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Modular Assembly (Submodules)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Here we assemble the architecture. The individual files contain the actual 
# implementation plans for the architecture -> vendor -> chip layers, core, etc.

include(cmake/toob_hal.cmake)
include(cmake/toob_core.cmake)
include(cmake/toob_crypto.cmake)
include(cmake/toob_stage0.cmake)
include(cmake/toob_libtoob.cmake)
include(cmake/toob_recovery.cmake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Final Executable & Post-Build Hooks
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 5.1 CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Build Fallback Logic
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    message(STATUS "No build type selected, defaulting to MinSizeRel.")
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "MinSizeRel" CACHE STRING "Choose the type of build." FORCE)
endif()

# 5.2 Define the final bootloader Target (toob_stage1)
add_executable(toob_stage1 $<TARGET_OBJECTS:toob_stage1_entry>)
toob_apply_strict_flags(toob_stage1 TRUE)

# 5.3 Architecture-Specific P10 Constraints and Core Libraries
# Core static library precedes HAL/chip and crypto archives so core symbols cannot be hijacked.
target_link_libraries(toob_stage1 PRIVATE toob_core)
if(TARGET toob_chip)
    target_link_libraries(toob_stage1 PRIVATE toob_chip)
endif()
if(TARGET toob_crypto)
    target_link_libraries(toob_stage1 PRIVATE toob_crypto)
endif()
if(TARGET toob_crypto_upstream)
    target_link_libraries(toob_stage1 PRIVATE toob_crypto_upstream)
endif()

# 5.4 Linker Script Integration
if(NOT TOOB_ARCH STREQUAL "host")
    # Prefer chip-specific Stage 1 linker script when provided (e.g. IRAM execution);
    # otherwise use the manifest-compiler generated flash_layout.ld.
    set(TOOB_STAGE1_USES_GENERATED_LD FALSE)
    if(EXISTS "${TOOB_HAL_CHIP_DIR}/${TOOB_CHIP}_stage1.ld")
        set(TOOB_LINKER_SCRIPT "${TOOB_HAL_CHIP_DIR}/${TOOB_CHIP}_stage1.ld")
        file(READ "${TOOB_HAL_CHIP_DIR}/${TOOB_CHIP}_stage1.ld" TOOB_STAGE1_CHIP_LD_CONTENT)
        if(TOOB_STAGE1_CHIP_LD_CONTENT MATCHES "INCLUDE[ \t]+flash_layout\\.ld")
            set(TOOB_STAGE1_USES_GENERATED_LD TRUE)
        endif()
    elseif(EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/flash_layout.ld")
        set(TOOB_LINKER_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/flash_layout.ld")
        set(TOOB_STAGE1_USES_GENERATED_LD TRUE)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "No linker script found for chip '${TOOB_CHIP}'!")
    endif()

    target_link_options(toob_stage1 PRIVATE -T${TOOB_LINKER_SCRIPT} -L${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated)

    # 5.5 Firmware Image Generation (.elf -> .bin) & Budget Check
    add_custom_command(
        TARGET toob_stage1 POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:toob_stage1> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:toob_stage1>/toob_stage1.bin
        COMMAND ${TOOB_CLI_PATH} budget --toml "${TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST}" --bin $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:toob_stage1>/toob_stage1.bin --stage stage1
        COMMENT "Generating flashable RAW binary toob_stage1.bin and checking flash budget..."
    )

    # 5.6 Dual-Link XIP Stage 1B Target (CRIT-43: single-compile object reuse + Stage1B origin)
    if(TOOB_STAGE1_USES_GENERATED_LD AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/flash_layout_stage1b.ld")
        add_executable(toob_stage1b $<TARGET_OBJECTS:toob_stage1_entry>)
        toob_apply_strict_flags(toob_stage1b TRUE)
        target_link_libraries(toob_stage1b PRIVATE toob_core)
        if(TARGET toob_chip)
            target_link_libraries(toob_stage1b PRIVATE toob_chip)
        endif()
        if(TARGET toob_crypto)
            target_link_libraries(toob_stage1b PRIVATE toob_crypto)
        endif()
        if(TARGET toob_crypto_upstream)
            target_link_libraries(toob_stage1b PRIVATE toob_crypto_upstream)
        endif()
        target_link_options(toob_stage1b PRIVATE -T${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/flash_layout_stage1b.ld -L${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
        set_target_properties(toob_stage1b PROPERTIES LINK_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/flash_layout_stage1b.ld")
        add_custom_command(
            TARGET toob_stage1b POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:toob_stage1b> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:toob_stage1b>/toob_stage1b.bin
            COMMAND ${TOOB_CLI_PATH} budget --toml "${TOOB_DEVICE_MANIFEST}" --bin $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:toob_stage1b>/toob_stage1b.bin --stage stage1b
            COMMENT "Generating flashable RAW binary toob_stage1b.bin and checking flash budget..."
        )
    endif()
endif()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Software Integration Testing / SIL (sandbox-replay Target)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(TOOB_ARCH STREQUAL "host")
    add_executable(sandbox-replay
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:toob_stage1_entry>
        test/host/enumerate_crash.c
        test/host/flash_model.c
        test/host/hal_tape.c
        test/host/invariants.c
        test/host/sandbox_platform.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_clock.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_console.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_crypto_policy.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_efuses.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_flash.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_rtc_ram.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_soc.c
        internal/mocks/mocks/mock_wdt.c
    )

    target_include_directories(sandbox-replay PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/toobloader/core/include
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/libtoob/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/internal/mocks/mocks
    )

    # Link modular libraries
    target_link_libraries(sandbox-replay PRIVATE toob_core toob_heatshrink)
    if(TARGET toob_crypto)
        target_link_libraries(sandbox-replay PRIVATE toob_crypto)
    endif()

    # K6-T4: Totality Check Target
    add_executable(intent-total
      test/host/intent_total.c
    )
    target_include_directories(intent-total PUBLIC
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/toobloader/core/include
      ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/libtoob/include
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/internal/mocks/mocks
    )
    target_link_libraries(intent-total PRIVATE toob_heatshrink)
    if(TARGET toob_crypto)
      target_link_libraries(intent-total PRIVATE toob_crypto)
    endif()

    # Recovery Roach-Motel Integration Test Target
    add_executable(test-recovery
      $<TARGET_OBJECTS:toob_stage1_entry>
      test/host/test_recovery.c
      test/host/flash_model.c
      test/host/hal_tape.c
      test/host/invariants.c
      test/host/sandbox_platform.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_clock.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_console.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_crypto_policy.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_efuses.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_flash.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_rtc_ram.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_soc.c
      internal/mocks/mocks/mock_wdt.c
    )
    target_include_directories(test-recovery PUBLIC
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/toobloader/core/include
      ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/libtoob/include
      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/internal/mocks/mocks
    )
    target_link_libraries(test-recovery PRIVATE toob_core toob_heatshrink)
    if(TARGET toob_crypto)
      target_link_libraries(test-recovery PRIVATE toob_crypto)
    endif()
endif()
